articles.title: $150M in Federal Funds for Beluga-Healy Electrical Intertie
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy awarded $150 million in defense readiness funds for an electrical intertie between Beluga and Healy.

articles.title: Trump claims South Korea will invest $50B in Alaska gas pipeline. Not so fast, Korean officials say
articles.summary: The South Korean trade minister said Trump's announcement "went beyond what was agreed" and denied that the country had committed to investing in the Alaska LNG project.

articles.title: Cameras in downtown Juneau parking garages aren’t Flock-branded
articles.summary: The five cameras on the map are all in Juneau’s parking garages, owned and managed by the city. But, the city said they’re not what people think.

articles.title: New interactive tsunami map helps Alaska communities prepare for the worst
articles.summary: The online map covers 66 coastal communities.

articles.title: Trump’s push for $50B Korean investment in Alaska gasline faces familiar economic challenges
articles.summary: Trump is pushing Korea to invest in Alaska LNG, and the Iran War has scrambled global energy flows. Is that enough to move a long-sought gasline forward?

articles.title: Drone research gets a lift from UAF ice tower
articles.summary: The ice tower of the Alaska Center for Unmanned Aircraft Systems Integration, ACUASI, at the University of Alaska Fairbanks Geophysical Institute is where research into wintertime drone flight happens.

articles.title: UAF joins $6M NSF critical minerals effort
articles.summary: UAF researchers are joining a four-year, $6 million National Science Foundation effort to explore how microorganisms and artificial intelligence can improve the recovery of critical minerals from coal waste.
